pages.text: $(italic)$(#6b5a45)Crafted at the Crafting Station. The four single-mode scepters need colony level 1; the Omni Scepter needs 10.$()$(br2)Items for commanding your colony's mages: toggle peace or follow, mark a creature as an ally, or force the colony to focus a target. The Omni Scepter rolls all four into one — shift+right-click to switch mode.
